verse.verse_2: For you (O dear Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him) are in this city.
verse.verse_3: And by oath of your forefather Ibrahim, and by you – his illustrious son!
verse.verse_4: We have indeed created man surrounded by hardships.
verse.verse_5: Does man think that no one will ever have power over him?
verse.verse_7: Does man think that no one saw him?
verse.verse_8: Did We not make two eyes for him?
verse.verse_9: And a tongue and two lips?
verse.verse_10: And did We not guide him to the two elevated things?
verse.verse_11: So he did not quickly enter the steep valley.
verse.verse_12: And what have you understood, what the valley is!
verse.verse_14: Or the feeding on a day of hunger.
verse.verse_16: Or of a homeless needy person!
verse.verse_17: And moreover to be of those who accepted faith, and who urged patience to one another and who urged graciousness to one another.
verse.verse_18: These are the people of the right.
verse.verse_19: And those who denied Our signs, are the people of the left.
verse.verse_20: Upon them is a fire, in which they are imprisoned, closed and shut above them.
